title: Presenting: Dear Chelsea with guest Josh Radnor

sentences.en: Hey, it's Josh.
We're excited to bring you something a little different today.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴今天能为您带来一点不一样的.

sentences.en: I recently sat down with Chelsea Handler on her podcast, Dear Chelsea.
sentences.zh: 我最近上了切尔西·汉德勒的播客节目《亲爱的切尔西》。

sentences.en: It was so much fun.
We talked about how we met, how we made out 20 years ago, sobriety, navigating fame, marriage, my love for New York City, and we got to give some advice to Chelsea's listeners.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了我们是如何相识的，20年前怎么接吻的，戒酒，如何应对名气，婚姻，我对纽约市的热爱，我们还给切尔西的听众们提了一些建议。

sentences.en: We're dropping my conversation with Chelsea into the feed here for you today.
sentences.zh: 今天我们把我和切尔西的这段对话放进节目里分享给大家。

sentences.en: This is a great podcaSt. Every week, Chelsea, along with her co-host, Catherine Law, and some pretty great guests,
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常棒的播客。每周，切尔西与她的联合主持凯瑟琳·劳以及一些相当不错的嘉宾一起，

sentences.en: takes on listener questions with that hilarious unfiltered edge she's known for.
sentences.zh: 以她那标志性的搞笑且毫无保留的风格回答听众的问题。

sentences.en: One minute, you'll be laughing about sex and weed, and the next, you're having a deeply moving conversation about grief or family.
sentences.zh: 上一秒你还在为性和大麻开怀大笑，下一秒你们就在进行一场关于悲伤或家庭的深情感人的对话。

sentences.en: It manages to be inspirational and heartbreaking all at once.
sentences.zh: 它既能激励人心，又让人心碎，两者完美结合。

sentences.en: You can check out Dear Chelsea wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 你可以在任何收听播客的地方找到《亲爱的切尔西》。

sentences.en: And while you're at it, Chelsea is actually on tour right now, bringing that same energy to the stage.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，切尔西目前正在进行巡演，把同样的能量带到了舞台上。

sentences.en: Head over to chelseahandler.com to grab your tickets.
sentences.zh: 前往 chelseahandler.com 抢购您的门票吧。
